# NocoBase UI Library catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-ui-library-catalog.mjs from ui-library/registry. Do not edit: change the item’s registry.json, then run `node scripts/gen-ui-library-catalog.mjs`. -->

Every item of the `@nocobase` shadcn registry (the NocoBase UI Library, previewed at https://ui.nocobase.com), as of this release of the Skill. A component installs into `client/components/` and a block into `client/extensions/nocobase-<item>/`; every item has a usage example, `@nocobase/<item>-demo`, to read before using it. Look an item up live first, as [section 3 of `styling.md`](styling.md#3-use-shadcn) says, and use this list when the registry cannot be reached.

## Agents

### agent-queue

An agent work queue: one lane per agent with the run in progress, what comes next and why it waits, and what waits for a person. Use it for an agents overview page. Presentational: map runs from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/runs and issues from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues to AgentQueueData.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/agent-queue`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-agent-queue/`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/agent-queue-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/agent-queue-demo`)
- After installing: Purely presentational: pass AgentQueueData (lanes built from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents runs and @nocobase/app-plugin-projects issues), the viewer, issueHref and onNavigate, and labels from your locale resources (English by default).

### agent-run-history

An agent's runs on one subject: a compact side-column log with a live timer, an all-runs dialog, the live pill, an activity row, a run's transcript and its brief. Use it beside a record agents work on. Presentational: map SubjectRun and Run from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents to AgentRunHistoryRun.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/agent-run-history`
- Installs to: `client/components/agent-run-history.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/agent-run-history-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/agent-run-history-demo`)
- After installing: Map your runs to AgentRunHistoryRun (newest first) and their events to RunTranscriptEvent; runHref and onOpenRun open a run, onStop and onRetry report actions for you to confirm and perform. Every word comes from the labels props, English by default. Pass complete events to RunTranscript; scope preferenceKey by application and user, and translate filterLabels.

### agent-composer

The message box for talking to an agent: page-context chips inside it, files to send (attach, paste, drop, uploaded before sending), Enter to send, Stop while the agent works, and a toolbar slot for a picker such as the agent's. Use it wherever a person writes to an agent. Presentational: context chips, drafts and focus come from the agents plugin's chat hooks (@nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat) through optional props.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/agent-composer`
- Installs to: `client/components/agent-composer.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: `@nocobase/app-plugin-agents`
- Example: `@nocobase/agent-composer-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/agent-composer-demo`)
- After installing: Pass onSend (return true, or a promise of true, once the message is taken), and optionally running, onStop, toolbar and notice; pass attachments (upload, and optionally discard and registerAdd; useChatAttachments of @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat uploads to the plugin) to send files; wire context (chips from contextChips and buildPageContext of @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat), draft and registerFocus from the chat panel when it sits in one. Every word comes from the labels prop, English by default.

### agent-picker

The one way to pick an agent: a trigger with the agent's avatar (availability dot on its corner) and name, and a menu of every enabled agent with what it is good at, its default and "personal runners only" tags, and why one cannot answer the viewer now (it cannot be picked then). Two appearances: field, which looks like a form's select, for forms and settings; toolbar, compact, for a composer. Presentational: pass ChatAgent records from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/shared/conversations.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/agent-picker`
- Installs to: `client/components/agent-picker.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: `@nocobase/app-plugin-agents`
- Example: `@nocobase/agent-picker-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/agent-picker-demo`)
- After installing: Pass the agents (useChatAgents from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat for chat, or useAgentOptions().agents from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/kit for a form), value and onSelect. appearance is field by default (noneOption offers no agent, placeholder, disabled, id for a label); appearance='toolbar' fits a composer, and bound marks an existing conversation, whose agent cannot change. Also exports AgentIdentity (avatar, dot and name as one row, for a picker that lists agents among people), AvailabilityDot, AgentTags and AgentTag. Every word comes from the labels prop, English by default.

### agent-chat

The agents' chat: a side panel beside the content area with the conversation, live steps, a composer with page-context chips and files to send (attach, paste, drop), the agent picker, the history, a full-page conversation view, and header, floating and Ask agent launchers. Use it to let people talk to agents from any page. Wired to the headless hooks of @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/agent-chat`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-agent-chat/`
- Plugin dependencies: `@nocobase/app-plugin-agents`
- Also installs: `@nocobase/markdown-view`, `@nocobase/agent-run-history`, `@nocobase/agent-composer`, `@nocobase/agent-picker`, `@nocobase/attachment-list`
- Example: `@nocobase/agent-chat-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/agent-chat-demo`)
- After installing: Requires the agents plugin (and the file plugin on the server for files sent in chat): wrap the routes in ChatProvider from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat (pass conversationPath when ChatConversationPage has a route such as /chat/:conversationId), optionally with ChatExtensionsContext for cards among the messages. Render ChatPanel as a sibling of <main> inside a `relative flex` row, ChatHeaderButton in the header and ChatFloatingButton anywhere; add the plugin's chatLinkRoutes(base) for links that open the panel; spread locales/ into client/locales/.

## Approval

### approval-ui

Presentational approval components: a request's progress through its stages with vote tallies, its history, the route a new request would take, parallel branches as a whole, a notice's receipts, and a bar of the actions the person may take.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/approval-ui`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-approval-ui/`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/approval-ui-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/approval-ui-demo`)
- After installing: Pure presentation: map your approval data into the shapes in types.ts (ApprovalStep, ApprovalTimelineLine, ApprovalRoute, ApprovalBranch, ApprovalReceipt, ApprovalBarAction) with translated labels, name people through ApprovalUiProvider, and merge locales/ into your locale resources.

## Authentication

### auth-forms

Password sign-in, sign-up, reset-request and reset forms. Use them on authentication pages. Presentational: wire onSubmit to the headless actions of @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/client/actions, as the templates' client/pages/auth/ pages do.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/auth-forms`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-auth-forms/`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/auth-forms-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/auth-forms-demo`)
- After installing: Presentational: each form calls onSubmit(values) and renders what it is given (submitting, error, fieldErrors, labels with English defaults). Wire onSubmit to @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/client/actions (the templates' client/pages/auth/ pages are the reference), pass translated labels, and put links in forgotPasswordLink and footer.

### auth-methods

Switches between several sign-in methods in tabs and lists single sign-on providers below them. Use it on a sign-in page offering more than a password. Presentational: each method's content is a form you wire, such as auth-forms over @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/auth-methods`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-auth-methods/`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/auth-methods-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/auth-methods-demo`)
- After installing: Pass methods as {id, label, content}; tabs appear only with more than one. Pass providers as {id, label, icon, onClick or href}; from three providers on they become icon buttons. Labels have English defaults; pass translated ones.

### auth-centered-layout

The page around an authentication form: the brand above a card in the middle of a muted page. Use it for sign-in, sign-up, password and device pages without a brand panel; the templates use auth-split-layout instead.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/auth-centered-layout`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-auth-centered-layout/`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/auth-centered-layout-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/auth-centered-layout-demo`)
- After installing: Render AuthCenteredLayout as the whole page of a sign-in, sign-up or password route, with the form as its children.

### auth-split-layout

The page around an authentication form: the form on the left and the application's own content on the right of a wide screen. Use it for sign-in, sign-up and password pages; the templates' client/pages/auth/shared.tsx renders it.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/auth-split-layout`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-auth-split-layout/`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/auth-split-layout-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/auth-split-layout-demo`)
- After installing: Render AuthSplitLayout as the whole page of a sign-in, sign-up or password route, with the form as its children and the application's own content in aside, shown from the xl breakpoint up.

### device-approval

The /device page where a signed-in person approves or denies the sign-in of a CLI or another device (RFC 8628 device authorization). Use it when a CLI signs in through the browser. Wired: calls Better Auth's device endpoints through useAuthentication() from @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/client.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/device-approval`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-device-approval/`
- Plugin dependencies: `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication`
- Example: `@nocobase/device-approval-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/device-approval-demo`)
- After installing: Needs wiring before it works: enable deviceAuthorization() and bearer() in server/config/auth.ts, add an application migration creating Better Auth's deviceCode table, and register deviceAuthorizationClient() in client/config/auth.ts. Render DeviceApproval on a /device route only signed-in people reach (auth: 'optional', sending others to /login?redirect=), passing ?user_code= as userCode, and spread locales/ into client/locales/. The authentication plugin's Skill (references/better-auth-plugins.md) has the details.

## Authorization

### permission-editor

A compact resource permission workspace with horizontal action checkboxes, adjacent data scopes and atomic visible selection.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/permission-editor`
- Installs to: `client/components/permission-editor.tsx`, `client/components/permission-filter.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/permission-editor-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/permission-editor-demo`)
- After installing: Map your permissions to sections of groups of rows; each row has an id, a label, an optional hint, whether it is enabled, and optionally the levels it can reach and the current one. onEnabledChange and onLevelChange report changes by row id. Every word comes through props, English by default. Resource groups render as compact rows with wrapping action checkboxes. Optional row.scopes bind independent scope selectors to their owning action. Pass onEnabledBatchChange to enable atomic group selection of visible toggleable permissions; omit it to keep single-action controls. Filtering never mutates the draft. Pass labels.selectVisible for the localized group checkbox name. Use group.accessOnly for a page with a single access action to show one title checkbox without redundant action text. Provide scope.configuration for parameterized scopes; PermissionFilter edits validated condition drafts and keeps role saving in the host form. Never save customFilter as a bare key: bind its native params.filter object.

## Data display

### kanban

A generic board: columns of cards dragged within and between columns, reporting each move through a callback. Use it for any board view, such as issues by status from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/kanban`
- Installs to: `client/components/kanban.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/kanban-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/kanban-demo`)
- After installing: Adapted from the Kibo UI kanban (MIT). Compose KanbanProvider, KanbanBoard, KanbanHeader, KanbanCards and KanbanCard; apply each onMove to your items and pass them back. Pass labels to translate the screen reader announcements.

### markdown-view

Markdown rendered as compact prose for descriptions and comments, with mention chips and fenced code a consumer may draw itself. Use it to display what rich-text-editor writes.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/markdown-view`
- Installs to: `client/components/markdown-view.tsx`, `client/components/remark-cjk-autolink.ts`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/markdown-view-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/markdown-view-demo`)
- After installing: Pass the Markdown as content. renderCodeBlock draws a fenced block itself, such as a mermaid diagram; mentionIcon picks a mention chip's icon by its kind. remarkCjkAutolink ends a bare URL at CJK text or full-width punctuation; add it after remark-gfm wherever else you render the same Markdown.

### long-text

A long text shown in part, the last line fading out instead of an ellipsis. LongText is for where there is room, such as the description under a page's title or a comment: five lines that unfold in place on a click. LongTextPreview is for a narrow column, such as a record's introduction or address beside its page: three muted lines whose whole text opens in a pop-up, so the column never grows. Neither reacts unless the text overflows.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/long-text`
- Installs to: `client/components/long-text.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/long-text-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/long-text-demo`)
- After installing: Pass the text as children; a string keeps its line breaks, and rendered content such as MarkdownView works too. LongTextPreview needs a label, the heading of the pop-up that shows the text whole.

### comment-thread

A record's activity line: comment threads with reactions, reply, edit, delete and resolve, the consumer's own entries between them, and a composer with modes and files. Use it for a record's discussion, such as an issue's comments from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/comment-thread`
- Installs to: `client/components/comment-thread.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Also installs: `@nocobase/rich-text-editor`
- Example: `@nocobase/comment-thread-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/comment-thread-demo`)
- After installing: Map your comments to CommentItem and threads to CommentThreadItem, oldest first, and put your own entries between them as custom entries (TimelineActivity draws a change). Every action is a callback that answers a promise; renderMarkdown draws the text (markdown-view suits it). Every word comes from labels, English by default.

### attachment-list

Files on a record or a message: image thumbnails and file chips with download, the files waiting to be sent, and a section that takes uploads. Use it to show and add files stored through @nocobase/app-plugin-file.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/attachment-list`
- Installs to: `client/components/attachment-list.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/attachment-list-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/attachment-list-demo`)
- After installing: Map your files to AttachmentFile. onPreview opens your own preview for every file; without it images open in the item's dialog and other files download. AttachmentPanel takes uploads through onUpload and confirms removals before calling onRemove. Every word comes from labels, English by default.

## Data entry

### property-fields

The fields of a record's property card: the titled card, label and value rows, a select, chips with creation, a date, a number, a line of text, a long text, a link, a person as a value, and a row of avatars. Use it for the side column of a detail page. PropertyCard draws its fields one of two ways: variant form shows every value in its control, and variant inline reads first, each value plain text that a double-click, Enter or F2 edits, shaded under the pointer, with a copy button on hover; a long text opens whole on a click, and a link, which a click opens, is edited from a pencil.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/property-fields`
- Installs to: `client/components/property-fields.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Also installs: `@nocobase/long-text`
- Example: `@nocobase/property-fields-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/property-fields-demo`)
- After installing: Values in, changes out: each field reports a change through onChange. Pass PropertyFieldLabels built from your locale resources for the words the fields show themselves. Set variant='inline' on PropertyCard for the read-first card, and give each field an aria-label, its name while it shows as text.

### rich-text-editor

A Markdown-in, Markdown-out rich text editor on official Tiptap extensions, with a composable toolbar, @mentions from an async search, pasted or dropped uploads, and room for your own extensions. Use it for descriptions and comments; store uploads through @nocobase/app-plugin-file.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/rich-text-editor`
- Installs to: `client/components/rich-text-editor.tsx`, `client/components/rich-text-markdown.ts`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/rich-text-editor-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/rich-text-editor-demo`)
- After installing: Give value and onChange (Markdown). onMentionSearch answers candidates for @query; mentions are stored as [@Name](mention://<kind>/<id>). onUpload stores a pasted or dropped file and answers its URL. extensions adds to or overrides richTextExtensions(); toolbar takes a render function, and RichTextToolbar, RichTextToolbarButton, RichTextInlineTools and RichTextBlockTools compose your own. Every word comes from labels, English by default.

## Diagrams

### flow-diagram

Read-only React Flow canvas with ELK orthogonal routing for directed graphs, including branches, cycles, parallel edges and self-loops. Use for interactive process views; pass nodes, edges and detail callbacks.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/flow-diagram`
- Installs to: `client/components/flow-diagram.tsx`, `client/components/flow-layout.ts`, `client/components/flow-diagram-css.d.ts`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/flow-diagram-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/flow-diagram-demo`)
- After installing: Pass nodes and edges with unique ids, an ariaLabel and either a bounded canvas height or autoHeight. Use direction DOWN with autoHeight for detailed page diagrams; height follows the full layout including outer routes and labels. The default node is 232×104 canvas units; set width/height for richer renderNode content. direction is RIGHT or DOWN. nodeDescription and nodeActions add supporting summaries and configuration controls. For bounded canvases, initialMinZoom=0.8 preserves initial readability and showMiniMap provides overview navigation; Fit still shows the whole graph. Translate flowDiagram.overview when using the minimap. onNodeClick/onEdgeClick open your details; onLayoutError reports invalid graph or layout failures. Translate flowDiagram.empty, loading, failed, nodeHelp and edgeHelp; see the components README. Includes React Flow CSS. Uses application primary/card/foreground/border tokens in light and dark themes. Ordinary edges are subdued, solid and labeled directly on the route. Set visited on nodes/edges for actual history and highlighted for the current node or available edges; current nodes have a stronger fill and ring. ELK optimizes port order to reduce crossings. Decorative nodes/edges are not focusable or selectable.

### lifecycle-diagram

Theme-aware, read-only lifecycle diagram using React Flow and ELK. Shows the current state, actual execution history, available transitions and optional end markers, with clickable state/transition details.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/lifecycle-diagram`
- Installs to: `client/components/lifecycle-diagram.tsx`, `client/components/lifecycle-diagram-model.ts`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Also installs: `@nocobase/flow-diagram`
- Example: `@nocobase/lifecycle-diagram-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/lifecycle-diagram-demo`)
- After installing: Pass description.description from useLifecycle/createLifecycleHook, currentState from view.record, availableTransitions filtered from view.available, and history from view.history.transitions. History matches the exact transition/source/destination; current state alone never implies a visited path. Pass a translated endLabel for separate decorative markers on explicit final states. Defaults to direction DOWN, autoHeight and initialMinZoom 0.7 for readable vertical page reading. The Fit control still shows the entire graph; an explicit initialMinZoom overrides the default. Override direction and autoHeight explicitly for compact canvases. stateActions supplies explicit configuration buttons; nodeDescription displays real policy summaries. Translate ariaLabel, stateLabel and transitionLabel; append a gear to automatic transition labels if needed. Edges are solid with inline labels and subdued neutral strokes; current/visited/available highlights use the application primary theme token. Current nodes have a stronger border and ring; icons, top accents and status footers distinguish current, visited and configurable nodes using theme tokens. onStateClick/onTransitionClick open details and never fire transitions. Keep toMermaid for documentation/export. Pass configuration={label, canConfigure, onConfigure} for automatic Configure buttons on authorized bound states and configuration selection on bound transitions. onConfigure receives the exact target and permitted bound fields grouped by native parameter key; connect the existing real editor and API. canConfigure is required and is only a UI affordance. Explicit direction/style overrides are reserved for user-requested customization; Mermaid is documentation/export only.

## Inbox

### inbox

The /inbox page over @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app: a master–detail list with All and To do views, a kind filter, cards clickable anywhere with a chevron, read, unread and delete, one detail header for every kind whose title links to the message's page, with the decision's buttons right under it, j / k navigation and realtime refresh. Use it for an application's inbox. Wired: reads the plugin's /client/inbox hooks; an InboxSource adds decisions that wait on the viewer, and a registry adds renderers per sender and categories such as plans from another API.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/inbox`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-inbox/`
- Plugin dependencies: `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app`
- Also installs: `@nocobase/page-header`
- Example: `@nocobase/inbox-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/inbox-demo`)
- After installing: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app registered on the server and client. Render <InboxPage /> from inbox-page.tsx on an /inbox route with auth: 'required', and spread locales/ into client/locales/. It lists the plugin's items as notifications; to add decisions that wait on the viewer, pass a source implementing InboxSource (source.ts) over your own API, and a registry with renderers and categories.

### inbox-button

A header button linking to the inbox, with an amber badge for what waits on the viewer or the unread count, its tooltip, and the browser tab title prefix. Use it in an application header. Presentational: pass inboxBadge(waiting, unread), with the unread count from useInboxUnreadCount() of @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client/inbox.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/inbox-button`
- Installs to: `client/components/inbox-button.tsx`, `client/components/inbox-badge.ts`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/inbox-button-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/inbox-button-demo`)
- After installing: Render <InboxButton badge={inboxBadge(waiting, unread)} /> inside a TooltipProvider, with inboxBadge from #components/inbox-badge, waiting what your inbox counts as waiting (0 without decisions) and unread from useInboxUnreadCount() of @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client/inbox; useDocumentTitleBadge(badge?.text ?? null) prefixes the tab title. Add the inboxButton.* keys its README lists to client/locales/.

## Other

### data-table

Standard TanStack Table v8 table with controlled server pagination and sorting, selection and column visibility.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/data-table`
- Installs to: `client/components/data-table/column-header.tsx`, `client/components/data-table/data-table.tsx`, `client/components/data-table/index.ts`, `client/components/data-table/pagination.tsx`, `client/components/data-table/view-options.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/data-table-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/data-table-demo`)
- After installing: Use DataTable with typed columns and getRowId. Server data must use manualPagination and manualSorting with controlled state; never sort or paginate only a fetched page locally. pagination=false renders every supplied row and leaves pagination to the caller.

## Page layout

### page-container

The frame of a page: full width, responsive padding, and the spacing between its sections. Use it as the outermost element of every page. Preinstalled in the templates.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/page-container`
- Installs to: `client/components/page-container.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/page-container-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/page-container-demo`)
- After installing: Wrap each page in PageContainer. Content rendered inside another page, such as an inline child route or a tab panel, adds none of its own.

### page-header

The heading of a page: its title, an optional description, and page-level actions. Use it once per page, inside PageContainer. Preinstalled in the templates.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/page-header`
- Installs to: `client/components/page-header.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/page-header-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/page-header-demo`)
- After installing: Render PageHeader once per page, as the first child of its PageContainer.

### settings-dialog

A settings dialog after shadcn's sidebar-13: grouped categories in a sidebar on the left, the open one on the right, a scrolling row on a phone. Use it for account or application settings that open over the current page.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/settings-dialog`
- Installs to: `client/components/settings-dialog.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/settings-dialog-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/settings-dialog-demo`)
- After installing: Pass groups of { id, label, icon } items, the activeId and onSelect (or renderItem to draw each entry as a router link), and render the open entry as children, optionally in a SettingsDialogSection. Every word comes from the props; the component ships no locale keys.

## Projects

### issue-table

The issues list: identifier, title with labels, status, priority, owner, executor and last update, with sorting and selection through callbacks. Use it for a list of issues. Presentational: map IssueListItem from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues to IssueTableRow.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/issue-table`
- Installs to: `client/components/issue-table.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/issue-table-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/issue-table-demo`)
- After installing: Map your issues (such as @nocobase/app-plugin-projects' IssueListItem) to IssueTableRow. Every word comes from the labels prop, English by default.

### issue-card

One issue, compact: identifier, title, status in its workflow colour, priority, owner and executor (person or agent), due date and labels, as a one-line row for lists or a stacked card for boards; one link or button, with slots for marks and trailing actions, and a loading skeleton. Use it wherever an issue is listed outside a table. Presentational: map the issues of @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues to IssueCardIssue.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/issue-card`
- Installs to: `client/components/issue-card.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Also installs: `@nocobase/issue-table`
- Example: `@nocobase/issue-card-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/issue-card-demo`)
- After installing: Map your issues (such as @nocobase/app-plugin-projects' IssueListItem) to IssueCardIssue, as for issue-table, which it installs for its status badge, priority and person. Pass href (with link for a router link) or onSelect. Add the issueCard keys (priority.urgent, priority.high, priority.medium, priority.low, due, overdue, owner, executor, loading) to your locale resources, or pass labels.

### issue-detail

An issue's page as presentational parts: the two-column frame of cards on the page background, the header and description opening the body card, an add bar under it, the secondary parts (sub-issues, dependencies with an issue search, files) as sections sharing one heading pattern and hidden while empty, files dropped or pasted on the body, and the side column over property-fields. Use it for an issue detail page over the hooks of @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/issue-detail`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-issue-detail/`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Also installs: `@nocobase/issue-table`, `@nocobase/issue-card`, `@nocobase/property-fields`, `@nocobase/rich-text-editor`, `@nocobase/comment-thread`, `@nocobase/attachment-list`, `@nocobase/markdown-view`
- Example: `@nocobase/issue-detail-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/issue-detail-demo`)
- After installing: Compose the page from the parts: IssueDetailLayout pads the page and stacks cards in both columns. The body is one card (IssueSurface, or ISSUE_SURFACE on the IssueFileDrop around it) opened by the header and description; every part below is an IssueSection (heading row with icon, name, count and actions over its content, a thin divider between), so draw your own sections with IssueSection too. A part with nothing to show renders nothing: put the buttons that add its first item in IssueAddBar under the description (IssueAddButton, IssueFilesButton; IssueDependencies opens its search through adding/onAddingChange), and wrap the body in IssueFileDrop so dropped or pasted files upload. Lay the activity out with comment-thread in a second IssueSurface below the body. Every part takes data through props and performs changes through callbacks (promises it waits for); feed them from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues. Links go through the link renderer. Build IssueDetailLabels from your locale resources.

### project-detail

A project's page as presentational parts: the header with progress, the overview's numbers, status distribution, description and members, the working directories (each linking to its settings page, with a row menu and an empty state), members and visibility settings, and the unreleased changes and previews. Use it for a project detail page over the hooks of @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/projects.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/project-detail`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-project-detail/`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Also installs: `@nocobase/issue-table`, `@nocobase/property-fields`, `@nocobase/rich-text-editor`, `@nocobase/markdown-view`
- Example: `@nocobase/project-detail-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/project-detail-demo`)
- After installing: Compose the page from the parts with your own tabs and sections between them; lay the properties out with property-fields. Every part takes data through props and performs changes through callbacks (promises it waits for); feed them from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/projects. Links go through the link renderer. Build ProjectDetailLabels from your locale resources.

### plan-card

An operation plan of @nocobase/app-plugin-projects as a card: the issues it is about, its changes row by row with whom each wakes and what it risks, execute with a second confirmation for risky rows, void, check again, undo within the window after a preview, and an in-place editor of an open plan's rows over property-fields; a frame prop lays its parts out under a header of the caller's, such as an inbox detail pane's. Use it wherever an agent's or a status rule's plan is reviewed and decided, such as a chat timeline, an inbox or a plan page. Wired: reads and acts through the plugin's headless hooks in /client/kit and its pure plan rules in /client/plan-model.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/plan-card`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-plan-card/`
- Plugin dependencies: `@nocobase/app-plugin-projects`
- Also installs: `@nocobase/property-fields`, `@nocobase/markdown-view`
- Example: `@nocobase/plan-card-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/plan-card-demo`)
- After installing: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-projects registered on the server and client, a router, and a QueryClientProvider with the application client's cache (which the plugin's plan announcements refresh) above the card. Render <PlanCard planId={id} /> from plan-card.tsx; it links the issues the plan is about under its title, firstIssueId (the issue it was opened from) first, and issueHref decides where each goes. Links go to the plugin's routes (/issues/plans/:id, /issues/:id, /projects/:id) unless the caller gives its own. Optionally provide PlanWordingContext from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/kit to word plans another plugin proposed, and spread locales/ into client/locales/.

## Route overlays

### route-dialog

A child route presented as a centered modal dialog, opened and closed by its URL. Use it for create and edit forms. Preinstalled in the templates.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/route-dialog`
- Installs to: `client/components/route-dialog.tsx`, `client/components/route-overlay.tsx`, `client/components/use-route-overlay.ts`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/route-dialog-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/route-dialog-demo`)
- After installing: Return RouteDialog from the component of a child route, and call useRouteOverlay() only from inside it. The close button is translated under routeOverlay.close; add it to your locale resources (Close, 关闭), or it reads Close in every language.

### route-drawer

A child route presented as a modal panel at the right edge, opened and closed by its URL. Use it for a record's details. Preinstalled in the templates.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/route-drawer`
- Installs to: `client/components/route-drawer.tsx`, `client/components/route-overlay.tsx`, `client/components/use-route-overlay.ts`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/route-drawer-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/route-drawer-demo`)
- After installing: Return RouteDrawer from the component of a child route, and call useRouteOverlay() only from inside it. The close button is translated under routeOverlay.close; add it to your locale resources (Close, 关闭), or it reads Close in every language.

### route-child-page

A child route presented as a non-modal page covering the content area, keeping the page beneath mounted. Use it for a drill-down that needs the whole content area. Preinstalled in the templates.

- Kind: component
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/route-child-page`
- Installs to: `client/components/route-child-page.tsx`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Example: `@nocobase/route-child-page-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/route-child-page-demo`)
- After installing: Return RouteChildPage from the component of a child route. It covers the nearest positioned ancestor, so render a page's own outlet beside its container rather than inside it. A child page that can only render inside another one, such as the child page of a tab, covers that one whole.

## Workflows

### workflow-management

Workflow administration as presentational parts: one management page with Definitions and Executions tabs, a categorized definition list, a filtered execution list, definition diagram and parameter layout, and execution history inspection beside a diagram. Wire it to application-owned routes, data and permissions.

- Kind: block
- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/workflow-management`
- Installs to: `client/extensions/nocobase-workflow-management/`
- Plugin dependencies: none
- Also installs: `@nocobase/page-container`, `@nocobase/page-header`, `@nocobase/data-table`
- Example: `@nocobase/workflow-management-demo` (`pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/workflow-management-demo`)
- After installing: Install @nocobase/workflow-management and read @nocobase/workflow-management-demo. Render WorkflowManagementLayout around the application Outlet with URL-controlled Definitions and Executions tabs; declare sidebar navigation only on the Workflow management parent. Pass adapted rows, translated labels, search/category controls, status/empty content and callbacks to WorkflowDefinitionList and WorkflowExecutionList. WorkflowDefinitionDetail places the diagram beside an application-owned parameter form. WorkflowExecutionDetail takes transition/effect records and a renderDiagram callback receiving the selected history prefix and current state; render with @nocobase/lifecycle-diagram or an existing compatible diagram. It never executes transitions or saves configuration. Keep API fetching, URL query state, permissions, parameter persistence, recovery actions and breadcrumbs in the application. All wording comes from props; no example plugin or backend is installed. Lifecycle diagrams are preinstalled in current app templates. Omit parameters to give a node-configured diagram full width, and open the same editor from LifecycleDiagram.configuration; supplying parameters retains the existing two-column layout.
